name: Supermarket Music
source:
A news network called Lynx partnered with a tech company called Schema to do something that should not be possible: broadcast a person's dreams, live, as TV programming.

The first show inside the technology is a game show called Supermarket Music. It airs whether you watch or not. The host is thrilled you tuned in. The contestants don't know they're contestants. The audience doesn't know what they're really watching.

You wake up inside it.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553340/Supermarket_Music/]Steam[/url]]
